question: What ingredients do the chefs mix with the eggs before cooking in each video, and how does this differ between them?

observed_information.statement: In v1, butter and milk are whisked into a frothy mixture before raw eggs are cracked into it and whisked together.
In v1, the egg mixture is poured into a heated pan and cooked until scrambled.
In v2, the displayed ingredients include two eggs, one tablespoon of butter, and half a cup of shredded cheese.
In v2, eggs are cracked into a metal bowl and whisked with a fork, with no additional ingredient visible during the whisking.
In v2, butter is placed in a frying pan and melted before the whisked egg mixture is poured in.
In v2, shredded orange and white ingredients are added on top of the cooking eggs and then fully mixed into the curds.

working_relations.statement: v1 adds eggs to a butter-and-milk mixture before cooking, while v2 shows eggs whisked with no additional ingredient visible before cooking and a shredded ingredient added during cooking.
v1 incorporates butter into the egg mixture before cooking, whereas v2 places butter in the pan before the egg mixture is poured in.

unresolved_issues.issue: The identity of the shredded orange and white ingredient added to the cooking eggs in v2 remains unresolved.
unresolved_issues.reason: The earlier ingredient display names shredded cheese, but the later addition is described only as shredded orange and white ingredients with uncertainty about the exact type.

unresolved_issues.issue: Whether the displayed cheese in v2 was mixed into the eggs before cooking remains unresolved.
unresolved_issues.reason: The whisking events show no additional ingredient visible, but they do not establish whether the cheese was added off-frame or only later during cooking.

candidate_requests.observable: Compare the visual appearance of the displayed shredded cheese with the shredded orange and white ingredient added to the pan.
candidate_requests.purpose: Identify whether the added ingredient is the cheese shown earlier.

candidate_requests.observable: Inspect the bowl contents and any ingredient additions during the egg-whisking span before the mixture is poured into the pan.
candidate_requests.purpose: Determine whether the cheese or any other displayed ingredient was mixed into the eggs before cooking.

validation_notes: 2 relations are evidence_partial: at least one video in scope either contributed no cited event or is still named by an unresolved issue
2 of those overlap an unresolved issue, so citing one event per video in scope was not enough to call them covered

run.ground_truth: In video A, the chef mixes mayonnaise and water with the eggs before cooking, creating an emulsion. In video B, the chef uses only plain cracked eggs without any additional ingredients. Video A's mixture includes dairy fat from mayo and hydration from water, while video B maintains a pure egg base.
